title: PayPal Account Suspension Phishing
description: Attackers impersonate PayPal and claim the victim's account is suspended. They direct victims to a fake login page to harvest credentials. The email creates urgency with phrases like 'verify immediately' or 'within 24 hours'.

title: Amazon Prime Renewal Scam
description: Fake Amazon emails claiming the victim's Prime subscription failed to renew. Victims are directed to update payment information on a fraudulent site that captures credit card data.

title: Apple ID Verification Scam
description: Users receive fake Apple security alerts claiming their Apple ID has been compromised. The phishing page mimics Apple's design to steal Apple ID credentials and two-factor codes.

title: Microsoft Office 365 Credential Harvest
description: Business email compromise targeting Office 365 users. Victims see fake Microsoft login pages after clicking links in spear-phishing emails about document sharing or password expiry.

title: Bank of America Account Alert
description: Fake bank security alerts urging customers to verify their identity after 'suspicious transactions'. Victims are sent to convincing fake banking portals that steal login and OTP codes.

title: IRS Tax Refund Phishing
description: Impersonating the IRS, attackers claim victims have an unclaimed tax refund. Victims are directed to a fraudulent site to submit personal information including SSN and bank details.

title: Netflix Password Reset Scam
description: Fake Netflix emails claiming user accounts have been temporarily suspended due to payment failure. Phishing pages harvest credentials and payment card details.

title: DHL Parcel Delivery Scam
description: Fake DHL delivery notifications claiming a parcel could not be delivered and requires a small fee to release. Victims enter payment card details on fraudulent DHL-branded portals.

title: LinkedIn Phishing via Job Offer
description: Attackers send fake LinkedIn job offers that redirect to phishing pages requesting resumes with personal details, or fake recruitment portals that harvest login credentials.

title: Google Account Unusual Activity Alert
description: Fake Google security alerts about unusual sign-in activity from an unknown device. Victims click through to a convincing Google login clone that captures passwords and recovery codes.

title: Chase Bank Fraud Alert Phishing
description: Fake Chase Bank fraud alerts via SMS and email claiming a suspicious payment was attempted. Victims are directed to fake Chase portals to freeze/secure their account.

title: Instagram Account Recovery Scam
description: Attacks targeting Instagram users with fake account recovery emails, claiming the account will be deleted unless the user verifies their identity immediately.

title: Crypto Exchange Phishing
description: Fake cryptocurrency exchange alerts (Coinbase, Binance) claiming withdrawal requests or suspicious login. Victims provide 2FA codes and recovery phrases enabling full account takeover.

title: FedEx Delivery Notification Scam
description: Fraudulent FedEx delivery notifications requesting payment for customs duties or delivery fees. Small payments anchor victims before escalating to larger credential theft.

title: PayPal Mobile Money Transfer Scam
description: Attackers create fake PayPal money transfer notifications indicating the victim received funds but must verify their account to claim them, leading to credential and payment theft.

title: Spotify Premium Cancellation Scam
description: Fake Spotify cancellation notices prompting users to re-enter payment details to avoid service termination. Victims submit card data on fraud sites mimicking Spotify's UI.

title: Wells Fargo Account Verification
description: Phishing campaign targeting Wells Fargo customers with fake alerts about identity verification requirements. Fake portals capture username, password, and OTP.

title: Business Email Compromise — Wire Transfer
description: Impersonating a CEO or CFO, attackers email finance employees requesting urgent wire transfers to attacker-controlled accounts. Uses spoofed or lookalike domains.

title: Fake COVID-19 Government Relief Scam
description: Government impersonation scams offering fake COVID-19 financial relief payments. Victims submit SSN, bank account details, and ID documents to fraudulent government portals.

title: Zelle Payment Scam
description: Scammers impersonate banks alerting victims to fraudulent Zelle transfers, then social-engineer them into 'reversing' the transfer by sending money to attacker-controlled accounts.

title: Phishing via Fake Invoice
description: Attackers send fake invoices from recognisable brands (QuickBooks, FreshBooks) claiming overdue payments. Links lead to credential-harvesting portals or malware downloads.

title: Tech Support Scam Pop-up
description: Malicious browser pop-ups displaying fake antivirus alerts urging users to call a fraudulent Microsoft support number, leading to remote access trojans and financial theft.

title: Package Rerouting Smishing
description: SMS-based phishing about undeliverable packages requiring the victim to click a link and pay a small rerouting fee, capturing card details in the process.

title: University Financial Aid Phishing
description: Students receive phishing emails claiming their financial aid requires reverification. Fake university portals harvest student ID, SSN, and banking details.

title: Account Takeover via Password Reset
description: Attackers trigger real password reset emails by knowing victim email, then race to intercept. Alternatively, fake reset emails redirect to phishing pages capturing new passwords.

title: Dropbox Document Access Scam
description: Fake Dropbox sharing notifications prompting users to log in to view shared documents. The phishing page harvests Microsoft or Google credentials used for Dropbox authentication.

title: Adobe Sign Document Phishing
description: Attackers send fake DocuSign or Adobe Sign requests requiring credential verification. The fake signing portals harvest victim credentials and company information.

title: Social Security Administration Scam
description: Phone and email scams impersonating the SSA, claiming the victim's Social Security number has been suspended due to suspicious activity, demanding personal information to resolve.

title: Lottery and Prize Scam
description: Victims told they've won a prize or lottery but must pay taxes/fees upfront to claim winnings. Personal information collected for identity theft alongside advance-fee fraud.

title: Romance Scam and Financial Exploitation
description: Long-term social engineering via dating platforms where attackers build emotional bonds before requesting money for fabricated emergencies, or involving victims in cryptocurrency fraud.

title: Fake Antivirus / Scareware
description: Pop-ups or emails claiming the user's device is infected with multiple viruses, urging them to download 'antivirus software' that is actually malware or ransomware.

title: WhatsApp Gift Card Scam
description: Attackers compromise WhatsApp accounts and message contacts asking them to buy gift cards for emergencies, providing redemption codes to the attacker.

title: Fake Job Application Data Harvesting
description: Fraudulent job postings on LinkedIn or Indeed collect resumes containing personal details. Fake HR portals request additional documents (SSN, banking for payroll) from candidates.

title: Airbnb Rental Scam
description: Fraudulent Airbnb listings with stolen photos. Victims are moved off-platform to pay via wire transfer or cryptocurrency, receiving nothing or arriving at a non-existent rental.

title: Phishing via Compromised Email Account
description: Attackers who gain access to a legitimate email account send phishing messages to all contacts, exploiting trust in the sender. Messages often contain urgent requests for money or credentials.

title: Fake Charity Scam
description: Solicitations impersonating real charities (Red Cross, UNICEF) collect donations that go directly to attackers. Often surge during natural disasters or global crises.

title: Booking.com and Hotel Phishing
description: Fake booking confirmation emails directing travellers to verify payment details. Also seen as message sent from compromised Booking.com hotel accounts requesting card re-verification.

title: Steam Gaming Platform Account Phishing
description: Attackers impersonate Steam support or friends, directing users to fake Steam login pages to steal gaming accounts and their valuable inventories or wallet funds.

title: Healthcare/Medicare Benefits Scam
description: Scammers impersonate Medicare or health insurance companies offering free equipment or updated cards in exchange for personal information used for medical identity theft.

title: Credential Phishing via Fake VPN
description: Corporate credential phishing using fake VPN login portals that mimic companies' internal systems, trapping employees into entering corporate credentials on attacker-controlled domains.

title: Deepfake CEO Voice Scam
description: AI-generated voice deepfakes of executives used in phone fraud to authorise large financial transfers. May be preceded by phishing emails to establish context.

title: QR Code Phishing (Quishing)
description: Physical or digital QR codes used in phishing attacks, bypassing email security scanning of URLs. When scanned, they redirect to credential harvesting pages or malware downloads.

title: Cloud Storage Invoice Scam
description: Fake billing emails for cloud storage services (iCloud, Google Drive) claiming storage is full and payment is required to avoid data loss.

title: Vishing — Phone-Based Credential Theft
description: Voice phishing attacks where callers impersonate bank fraud departments, convincing victims to provide OTPs, PINs, and account details in real-time to authorise takeovers.

title: Fake Scholarship Scam
description: Students offered fake scholarships requiring an application fee or personal details. Attacker websites mimic educational foundations to collect advance fees and identity data.

title: PayPal Unauthorized Payment Alert
description: Fake PayPal security alerts about an unauthorized payment being processed. Victims call a fraudulent number or visit a phishing site to 'cancel' the transaction.

title: Ransomware Email Delivery
description: Malicious email attachments (fake invoices, shipping notifications) containing ransomware. Once opened, encrypts victim files and demands cryptocurrency ransom for decryption.

title: Tax Authority E-Filing Phishing
description: Phishing sites mimicking tax authority portals (HMRC, IRS, CRA) during tax season, collecting login credentials, tax file numbers, and banking information for refund fraud.

title: Fake Antivirus Renewal
description: Emails impersonating McAfee or Norton claiming the victim's antivirus subscription expired and a large renewal charge is imminent, urging them to call a fraudulent number.

title: Supply Chain Phishing Attack
description: Attackers target vendors/suppliers of a target company, compromising their email to send convincing phishing or malware to the main target under a trusted vendor identity.
